children: UK intelligent operations platform's H1 revenue rose 3%, recurring revenue up 4% to 97% of total
Company achieved adjusted EBITDA profit after cost reductions, versus loss in prior year
Retirement of legacy product simplified operations, cut costs and reduced ARR
Checkit targets net revenue retention of 105–110% and gross revenue retention above 95% over two years
Company plans disciplined investment in platform unification and go-to-market execution to support growth
Checkit aims to balance investment with financial discipline, prioritising quality and capital efficiency of growth
COST REDUCTION - Co said improved adjusted EBITDA was driven by cost reduction programme and operating leverage
RECURRING REVENUE - Higher proportion of recurring revenue contributed to improved gross margin and profitability
LEGACY PRODUCT RETIREMENT - Retirement of legacy product reduced ARR but simplified operations and cut annualised costs
